messages.同じ敵(部位)を殴り続けて「点穴 - ホンル」を3まで積み、各スキルのコイン再使: An Identity specialized for single targets. Keep attacking the same enemy or part to build 3 Nerve Strike - Hong Lu, then use Coin reuse on each skill to deliver Burn and damage.
messages.点穴 - ホンル: 常時パッシブ「立ち合いの下での決闘」により、基本攻撃スキルで: **Nerve Strike - Hong Lu**: Through the always-active passive A Duel Witnessed, inflicts 1 next turn on the last target hit by his basic attack skills (once per turn, up to 3; inflicted on parts in Focused Encounters). Clash Power and Base Power rise with the number of stacks. Applying it to another target removes the previous stacks.
messages.バトルパッシブ「草炎玉球」(憤怒×2・傲慢×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ: **Combat passive — Virescent Pyrojade (2 Wrath and 2 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Clash Win, inflicts 1 more Nerve Strike if the target has it, once per turn. Grants Haste next turn based on Poise Potency, up to 2, and raises Critical damage based on the target's Burn Potency. An important effect for stacking Nerve Strike quickly.
messages.点穴でコイン再使用: S1「発勁」は点穴3以上、S2「草炎掌」は2以上、S3「最: **Coin reuse from Nerve Strike**: S1 Fa Jin reuses a Coin at 3 or more Nerve Strike, S2 Virescent Flame Palm at 2 or more, and S3 Take the Hit to the Last Blow, Please? whenever the target has Nerve Strike (once per skill).
messages.速度差と呼吸・火傷: 各スキルは対象より速いほど、また自分の呼吸と対象の火傷の合: **Speed difference, Poise, and Burn**: Each skill gains power the faster he is than the target, and the more his Poise plus the target's Burn totals. S2 and S3 gain Poise on Clash Win.
messages.立合い - 東部センク: ステージ初登場時、待機・サポート人員のセンク協会所属人: **Witnessed - Eastern Cinq**: On first appearing in a stage, he gains 1 per Cinq Association Identity in backup or support, up to 3. Raises Offense Level and Poise gain.
messages.狙う敵(部位)を1つに決めて殴り続け、点穴を積む。傲慢・憤怒を味方からも集めて「: Pick one enemy (or part) to target and keep hitting it to stack Nerve Strike. Gathering Pride and Wrath from allies to activate Virescent Pyrojade early lets Clash Wins stack Nerve Strike too, reaching reuse sooner. Don Quixote's Cinq Assoc. East Section 3 also inflicts Nerve Strike - Don Quixote, and one character's Nerve Strike replaces the other's, so deploying them together means competing for Nerve Strike. There is little need to line up Cinq Association Identities in backup just to max out Witnessed.
